assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are suggestive of sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered.
The telemetry is ordered to detect arrhythmic events.
The telemetry is ordered to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The service in question is CPT 93229.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197.
